owner_summary.aabb_work_scope: new exact AABB work for changed skin faces against every supplied target; unchanged baseline pairs are reused without AABB retest

limits: Single pose only; replay ran concurrently with the existing fitter on the shared Mac mini.
No source, owner, active fit, or native input was modified.
Exact equality is against the frozen pose-0 retained sidecar, not an anatomical qualification.

memory_estimate.limits: Projection estimates only returned exact-record Python object graphs; not allocator/RSS, caches, arrays, or AABB trees. Across-pose exact records cannot be reused unless target geometry hashes match.
memory_estimate.samples_method: recursive sys.getsizeof with object-identity de-duplication on five target record lists selected by face-count quantile

scope: one offline exact incremental target scan, pose 0 at accepted step 0; no native simulation

timing_s.note: Timers wrap frozen owner functions; predicate-only time is measured around triangle_intersection_points. Python instrumentation and shared-host contention affect wall time.
